# Reports & Dashboards

Config key: `settings.reportsAndDashboards`

!!! danger "Irreversible"
    Once applied, `folderSharing.enableEnhancedFolderSharing` cannot be changed back.

Setup: **Feature Settings → Analytics → Reports & Dashboards → Folder Sharing**

Enables Enhanced Folder Sharing. Orgs created after the Summer ’13 release already have it.

## Example

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/src/plugins/schema.json",
  "settings": {
    "reportsAndDashboards": {
      "folderSharing": {
        "enableEnhancedFolderSharing": true
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Fields

| Field | Type | Description | Values | Default |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- | ------ | ------- |
| `folderSharing.enableEnhancedFolderSharing` | boolean | Enable access levels for sharing report and dashboard folders<br>Cannot be disabled once enabled.<br>**Irreversible:** cannot be changed back once applied. |  |  |
